senses.gloss: घ्रं॑स् m. the sun's heat, AV. vii, 18.
घ्रंस॑ m. id., RV. i, 116, 8; vii, 69, 4; Kauś. 48
sunshine, brightness, RV. v, 34, 3 and 44, 7.
घ्राण mfn. (viii, 2, 56) smelled, L.
smelling (घ्रातृ), L.
घ्राण m. n. smelling, perception of odour, ŚBr. xiv; Mn.; BhP.
घ्राण m. smell, odour, ŚāṅkhGṛ. iv, 7; MBh. iii, 12844
घ्राण n. the nose, ChUp. viii, 12, 4; MBh. &c. (ifc. f(आ). , Kathās. lxi; Hcat.)
घ्राण , घ्रात॑, &c. See √ घ्रा.
घ्राणा f. the nose, VarBṛS. of a bull, lxi, 15.
घ्राण—चक्षुस् mfn. ‘using the nose for eyes’, blind, MBh. viii, 3443.
घ्राण—ज mfn. caused or produced by the nose, W.
घ्राण—तर्पण mfn. pleasant to the nose, fragrant, Hariv. 3710
घ्राण—तर्पण n. odour, perfume, R. ii, 94, 14; Rājat. v, 356.
घ्राण—दुःख-दा f. ‘giving pain to the nose’, Artemisia sternutatoria, Bhpr. v, 3, 304.
घ्राण—पाक m. the disease of the nose called नासा-प्˚, Sāṃkhyak. 49, Sch.
घ्राण—पुटक (ifc. f(आ). ) nostril, MārkP. lxv, 22.
घ्राण—बिल n. the cavity of the nose, TPrāt. ii, 52, Sch.
घ्राण—श्रवस् m. ‘renowned for his nose’, N. of one of Skanda's attendants, MBh. ix, 2559.
घ्राण—स्कन्द m. blowing one's nose, Rājat. v, 417.
घ्राणेन्द्रिय n. the organ or sense of smell, Jain.; Suśr.
घ्रात॑ mfn. (Pāṇ. viii, 2, 56) smelled, VS. xx, 7
having smelled, MBh. vii, 5228 (ifc.)
perceiving, witnessing, feeling, Rājat. ii, 22 (ifc.)
घ्रातव्य᳙ n. ‘to be smelled’, odour, ŚBr. xiv, 7, 1, 24 and 3, 17; PraśnUp. iv, 8; Bhartṛ. i, 7.
घ्राति f. smelling, perception of odour, BṛĀrUp. iv, 3
snuffling at, Mn. xi, 68
the nose, L.
घ्रातृ॑ mfn. one who smells, ŚBr. xiv; MBh.
घ्रां॑ ind. See घृ॑ङ्.
